title: N+1 query counter
prompt: Given `orders` (List<string> ids) each needing one query for its lines: a naive loop issues 1 + N queries. Implement `static int NaiveQueries(int orderCount)` = orderCount + 1, and `static int BatchedQueries(int orderCount, int batchSize)` = ceil(orderCount / batchSize) + 1 (batch IN-queries). Then implement `static (int naive, int batched, double saved) Compare(int orderCount, int batchSize)` returning all three with saved = round((naive − batched) / naive × 100, 2).

tests.name: query-math
